data.name: Add or remove personnel by shift
data.value: 按班次添加或移除人员

data.name: Auto-suggestions have not been saved. Adjacent schedules will be re-validated upon generation; existing saved arrangements will not be overwritten.
data.value: 自动建议尚未保存。生成时将重新验证相邻排班；不会覆盖已保存的安排。

data.name: Changes take effect only after saving. Collapsing these tools keeps your draft.
data.value: 更改仅在保存后生效。折叠这些工具不会丢失草稿。

data.name: Copy Current Week to Next Week

Copy the current week's draft to the next week. If the next week already has shifts or modifications, confirmation is required before copying; saving is still required after copying. Vertical buttons on the sides can expand the 36 hours before and after the current week; gray areas are read-only. Charts and forms on this page only edit the current week; to adjust adjacent weeks, switch to the corresponding week. The next week's draft after copying is also previewed in read-only mode. Changes to the current week and copies are saved, undone, and restored uniformly; collapsing does not lose drafts.
data.value: 将当前周的草稿复制到下一周。如果下一周已有班次或修改内容，复制前需要确认；复制后仍需保存。两侧的垂直按钮可展开当前周前后各 36 小时的内容；灰色区域为只读。本页面的图表和表单仅用于编辑当前周；如需调整相邻周，请切换到对应的周。复制后，下一周的草稿也会以只读模式预览。当前周的修改和复制内容统一保存、撤销和恢复；折叠后草稿不会丢失。

data.name: Currently in Mobile/Swap mode. Switch the mode above before adding or removing shifts.
data.value: 当前处于移动/交换模式。添加或删除班次前，请先切换上方的模式。

data.name: Currently in Move/Swap mode. Switch the mode above before adding or removing shifts.
data.value: 当前处于移动/交换模式。添加或删除班次前，请先切换上方的模式。

data.name: Drag a color block to another shift to swap personnel, or to an empty slot to move the shift; drag 'Swap Entire Week' to exchange two people's weekly schedules. You can also click to select, then click the target; press Esc to cancel. Changes display immediately and can be saved in bulk after multiple adjustments.
data.value: 将一个彩色方块拖到另一个班次上可交换人员，拖到空班次上可移动班次；拖动“交换整周”可互换两人的整周排班。也可以点击选择，再点击目标位置；按 Esc 取消。更改会立即显示，多次调整后可一次性保存。

data.name: Generate and save applies a new automatic schedule immediately.
data.value: 点击“生成并保存”后，将立即应用新的自动排班。

data.name: Generate and save this week's schedule
data.value: 生成并保存本周的排班

data.name: Next week already has a saved schedule or unsaved changes. Copying will replace the full 21 shifts of next week with the current draft of this week. You can still undo after confirmation; changes are only written when you click Save.
data.value: 下周已经有已保存的排班或未保存的更改。复制后，下周的全部 21 个班次都将被本周当前的草稿替换。确认后仍可撤销；只有点击“保存”后，更改才会写入。

data.name: On-call personnel (multiple allowed, at least one)
data.value: 值班人员（可多选，至少选择一人）

data.name: Red alerts indicate empty shifts, insufficient rest, or below minimum headcount, but do not block further adjustments. Saving is allowed even if below minimum headcount, but empty shifts and insufficient rest cannot be saved. Validation is applied uniformly across the modified week, adjacent weeks, and other teams upon saving. If any week fails validation, nothing is saved. Departed members can only retain their original shifts; new shifts cannot be added or copied.
data.value: 红色警告表示存在空班次、休息时间不足或人数低于最低要求，但不会阻止继续调整。即使人数低于最低要求，也可以保存；但空班次和休息时间不足时无法保存。保存时会统一校验已修改的周、相邻周以及其他团队的排班。任何一周未通过校验，所有内容都不会保存。已离职成员只能保留原有班次，不能为其添加或复制新班次。

data.name: Select time slots to add or remove on-shift personnel; the chart will update synchronously. You can also use this form for keyboard navigation. Cross-group members can be selected manually; gray read-only shifts from other teams will not be modified, and cross-group overlaps and breaks are still validated upon saving.
data.value: 选择要添加或移除值班人员的时间段；图表将同步更新。您也可以使用此表单通过键盘进行操作。可以手动选择跨组成员；其他团队的灰色只读班次不会被修改，保存时仍会校验跨组时间冲突和休息时间。

data.name: Coverage, staffing and rest issues are reminders and do not prevent saving. Invalid time intervals, non-team assignees and version conflicts prevent saving. Departed members may retain their original assignments.
data.value: 覆盖、人数和休息问题仅作提醒，不阻止保存。无效时间、非团队值班人和版本冲突会阻止保存。离队成员可保留原安排。

data.name: On-call personnel (zero or more)
data.value: 值班人（允许无人或多人）

data.name: Enter times in the team time zone. During daylight saving transitions, skipped times are invalid and repeated times use standard time.
data.value: 请按团队时区输入。夏令时切换期间，跳过的时刻无效，重复的时刻采用标准时间。

data.name: Copy or generate into a time range
data.value: 复制或生成到某个时间范围

data.name: Copy repeats the visible draft across the destination range, clipping at its boundaries. Existing intersecting shifts are replaced in full.
data.value: 复制会在目标范围内重复当前草稿，并裁剪至范围边界。与目标范围相交的已有班段将被整体替换。

data.name: The following shifts will be replaced. Confirm to write the new schedule.
data.value: 以下班段将被替换。确认后写入新排班。

data.name: Precise editing / bulk operations
data.value: 精确编辑 / 批量操作

data.name: Select a shift in the chart, then choose a team member and start time. Its duration stays the same.
data.value: 先在图中选择班次，再选择团队成员和开始时间。班次时长保持不变。

data.name: Exchange two current team members across all shifts in the visible range.
data.value: 交换当前显示范围内两名在队成员的所有班次。

data.name: Copy repeats the visible draft across the destination range, clipping at its boundaries. Existing intersecting shifts are replaced in full. Copying and generation only change drafts; use Save schedule adjustments to publish.
data.value: 复制会在目标范围内重复当前草稿，并裁剪至范围边界。与目标范围相交的已有班段将被整体替换。复制和生成仅修改草稿；点击“保存排班调整”后才会发布。

data.name: The following shifts will be replaced in the draft. Confirm to update the draft; saved schedules change only when you save.
data.value: 以下班段将在草稿中被替换。确认后仅更新草稿；点击保存后才会修改已发布的排班。

data.name: Arrow keys move time or person; Shift + arrows resize; Enter edits; Delete removes.
data.value: 方向键调整时间或人员；Shift + 方向键调整边界；Enter 编辑；Delete 删除。

data.name: Shift has no on-duty engineers.
data.value: 班次未安排值班工程师。

data.name: An engineer has insufficient rest between shifts.
data.value: 有工程师的班次间休息时间不足。

data.value: 有工程师的连续值班时间超过提醒阈值。

data.name: Shift staffing is below the team threshold.
data.value: 班次人数低于团队提醒阈值。

data.name: Future shift includes a departed team member.
data.value: 未来班次包含已离队成员。

data.name: Remove departed members before changing shift times.
data.value: 请先移除已离队成员，再修改班次时间。

data.name: The destination must not overlap the visible range or another copied range.
data.value: 目标范围不能与当前显示范围或其他已复制范围重叠。

data.name: Choose two different current team members.
data.value: 请选择两名不同的在队成员。

data.name: Copied range is a draft. Save to publish.
data.value: 已复制的范围仍为草稿，保存后才会发布。
